title: Silver-Tongued and Sundry: Exploring Intersectional Pronouns with ChatGPT

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying human participants to rate the perceived gender (masculine, feminine, gender ambiguous, or genderless) of a ChatGPT agent based on its use of ten different Japanese first-person pronouns in generated text.
Surveying human participants to categorize the perceived age group (from child to older adult) of the ChatGPT agent based on the specific Japanese first-person pronouns it used.

Analyzing open-ended participant descriptions for regional stereotypes (urban vs. rural) evoked by the AI's pronoun usage, and measuring similarity-to-self ratings among participants from two distinct Japanese regions (Kanto and Kinki).
Evaluating free-text participant impressions to code the perceived formality (e.g., formal/classy vs. casual/rough) of the AI persona based on its first-person pronoun use.
